## Invitations

The East City outreach report for 2022 Q1 records 1828 invitations and 928 attendances. This represents an attendance rate of 50.8 per cent. The figures provide a summary of invitation activity and attendance during the reporting period.

Of the people invited, 928 attended. The attendance rate was calculated against the total of 1828 invitations issued. This information will support routine review of outreach activity and participation.

## Contact

SMS was used for 1573 invitations. No reminder messages were recorded, with the reminder total reported as 0. The contact information distinguishes between invitations issued by SMS and subsequent reminder activity.

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments as part of ongoing follow-up. This contact activity remains separate from the SMS invitations and the recorded reminder total.

Prepared by G. Evans.
